description: This file defines the AppDatabase class for an Android app using Room library. It specifies the database schema, including entities and DAOs for calendar events, leaves, and astrology data, and provides a singleton instance for database access.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class extending RoomDatabase; defines DAOs for data access and singleton pattern for database instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating the database if it doesn't exist.
